description: Desktop launch defaults that run.conf and play_p2 set by environment variable, as variables and switches: physics (PHYSICS, PHYSICS_ARGS), the job graphs (JOB_ARGS), the queued material system (QUEUE_ARGS / +mat_queue_mode in EXTRA_ARGS). Each game profile sets the values its launcher uses and splices them where its launcher puts them.

serial-jobs.description: The job graphs at the engine defaults (JOB_ARGS=)

sync-queue.description: The material system unqueued (QUEUE_ARGS=, mat_queue_mode at its saved value)
